title: Partial Withdrawals from Ashgrove Fixed Indexed Annuities — Free Amount, Surrender Charge and Bonus Recapture
content:
**Servicing note — partial withdrawals, Fixed Indexed Annuities**

### Conditions of payment

1. A partial withdrawal is paid only while the contract status is active or income phase.
2. A partial withdrawal is paid only on a withdrawal request signed by the owner and approved.
3. Each withdrawal must be at least the tier's smallest partial withdrawal and leave at least the tier's contract value that must remain after a partial withdrawal.

Conditions 1 and 2 are read from Ashgrove's records before payment: the status on the record of the same contract, and, on the service request record of that same withdrawal request, its request type, its signed date and an approved request status. A statement by the caller does not stand in for either record.

### Charge calculation

**Free amount remaining.** From the tier's first contract year of free withdrawals, withdrawals in a contract year up to the tier's free withdrawal share of the anniversary value, less the withdrawals already taken in that contract year, are free. The free amount remaining is the free withdrawal share multiplied by the anniversary value, rounded to the cent, less the withdrawals already taken, and never below zero. Before that first contract year no free amount exists.

- *Anniversary value*: the contract value on the latest contract anniversary on or before the withdrawal date; in the first contract year, the initial premium plus any premium bonus.
- *Withdrawals already taken*: the total of withdrawals paid on the same contract in the current contract year — from the latest anniversary — before the withdrawal being priced.

**Excess part.** The withdrawal amount less the free amount remaining, never below zero.

**Surrender charge.** The excess part multiplied by the surrender charge percentage for the contract year from the tier's schedule, rounded to the cent.

**Bonus recapture (bonus tier).** On a bonus tier the excess part also bears a recapture of the unvested bonus in proportion to the excess part over the contract value: the unvested bonus multiplied by the excess part, divided by the contract value from which the withdrawal is taken. The unvested bonus is the premium bonus credited multiplied by one less the vested share for the contract year.

**Required minimum distributions.** Required minimum distributions are free where the tier's required-minimum-distribution waiver applies.

### Worked examples (hypothetical figures)

**A. Ashgrove IndexEdge 7, contract year 3 (schedule 7%), free share 10%.** Anniversary value 150000; withdrawals already taken this contract year 6000; requested withdrawal 20000.
Free share: 10% of 150000 is 15000.00. Free amount remaining: 15000.00 less 6000 is 9000.00. Excess part: 20000 less 9000.00 is 11000.00. Surrender charge: 11000.00 multiplied by 7% is 770.00.

**B. Ashgrove IndexEdge 10 Bonus, contract year 4 (schedule 7%, vested share 30%), free share 10%.** Anniversary value 107000; no earlier withdrawals this contract year; contract value 110000; bonus credited 7000; requested withdrawal 30000.
Free amount remaining: 10700.00. Excess part: 19300.00. Surrender charge: 19300.00 multiplied by 7% is 1351.00. Unvested bonus: 7000 multiplied by 70% is 4900.00. Recapture: 4900.00 multiplied by 19300.00, divided by 110000, is 859.7272…

**C. Ashgrove IndexEdge 5, contract year 1 (schedule 8%).** Requested withdrawal 5000. No free amount exists in contract year 1, so the excess part is 5000 and the surrender charge is 400.00.

**D. Ashgrove IncomeShield 7, contract year 5.** Anniversary value 90000, no earlier withdrawals this year, requested withdrawal 4000. Free amount remaining 9000.00 exceeds the request, so the excess part is zero and no surrender charge arises.

### Status table

| Contract status on the record | Partial withdrawal paid? |
|---|---|
| active | Yes, if the other conditions hold |
| income phase | Yes, if the other conditions hold |
| applied, guaranteed payout, surrendered, annuitized, death claim pending or any other status | No |
